title: Sonic Racing CrossWorlds drops to $39.99 + Godzilla 🏁
subject: sonicracing
description:
Which Year 2 crossover are you most excited for? 👇

Sega revealed Sonic Racing CrossWorlds Year 2 on October 9, 2026 and permanently cut the Standard Edition from $69.99 to $39.99 and the Digital Deluxe Edition to $59.99. Year 2 starts November 3 with free Bayonetta and the Godzilla pack, part of a $29.99 Season Pass 2 with 6 crossover packs through 2027.

Sources: Sega via Gematsu (Oct 9, 2026), VGC (Oct 10, 2026), Shacknews (Oct 9, 2026), Handheld Guru (Oct 10, 2026)
Game footage/images © their respective owners.

scenes.text: Sonic Racing CrossWorlds just got $30 cheaper.
Sega permanently cut the Standard Edition from $69.99 to $39.99, and the Digital Deluxe to $59.99.
Year 2 starts November 3, when Bayonetta joins for free.
The $29.99 Season Pass 2 adds 6 crossover packs, starting with Godzilla attacking City Escape.
Evangelion follows in January, then Hello Kitty, Segaland, Final Fantasy VII Remake and Persona through 2027.
A McLaren car arrives later in November, and Persona 3's Aigis joins for free in early 2027.
